How it works

Three steps

  1. 01

    Type

    It auto-tags what you type: actions, names, dates.

  2. 02

    It changes itself

    Pages, menus, layout and look change right on your stage.

  3. 03

    Undo anything

    Replay the whole session, undo, redo and branch freely, step by step.

    Merge is coming soon.

In the app today

What you can do right now

It edits itself

live

Ask for a page, a menu, a layout or a new look. It changes itself and says what changed, with one Undo.

Tags as you type

live

Names, dates and actions light up while you type. Tap a tag to change what it means.

Click to rename

live

Click a stage’s name in the top bar and type a new one.

Your tags as a graph

live

Every tag you have typed, linked when they shared a line. Or see them as a table, list, board or timeline.

Actions

live

Everything you asked and everything it did, with status, model and cost. List, table, board or timeline.

Skins and the library

live

Open a skinned terminal from the library, or skin any part of a stage in words.

Safe when offline

live

A prompt typed with no connection waits. When you are back, send it, edit it or drop it.

experimental

Step back through a session and watch the stage rebuild. Export a session as a file.

One quiet bar

One row on top; every tool is in one short menu, including Buy credits and Terminal-talk (experimental).

Privacy

Private from us by default

Stays in your browser

live

No account needed. Your stages live in this browser until you sign in.

Sharing is off

live

“Share my data” is off by default. We see an account only if you grant access.

Your key skips us

live

With your own OpenRouter key, calls go straight from your browser to OpenRouter.

Encrypted with your key

coming

Today privacy is a rule our code keeps. Next: encryption only you can open.

On free usage your prompt passes through our router on its way to the model. We keep the cost, not your words.
